## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      10 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 17 sept 2026 - 27 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Gayle Warren_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "I thought I had cancelled this correctly via email. But I see you took a payment from my Visa without consent. $89.99 please ensure my account/subscription is CANCELLED I don't require it!"
            2. _Riina_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "SCAM! FORCED SUBSCRIPTION IMPOSSIBLE TO CANCEL!"
            3. _Uyen Vo_, 25 sept 2026, 1/5: "The app automatically charge my credit card eventhough I cancelled subscription already."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 23 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, 23 sept 2026, 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23 jul 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
